full_voiceover_script: If you want to work in caregiving in Washington, do not guess your first step. A lot of adults get stuck because they are not sure what training they actually need, how online it is, or what it costs to begin. ExcelCNA offers DSHS-approved HCA training for adults who want a practical way to get started. The program is mostly online, which can make it easier to fit around work, family, or a career change. And if cost is what is stopping you, the starting payment is ninety-five dollars down. You are not trying to figure this out from random posts or outdated advice. You can look at the training details, see how the path works, and decide if it fits your next move. If caregiving is the direction you want, tap to view the HCA page and take the next step. Tap to see the HCA training details and enroll when you're ready.
